title: Play build leaves sync out (option B) instead of declaring the data-sync foreground service
context: Play Console will not save the 1.0.0 Closed testing (Alpha) draft until the app's FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC permission is declared with a demo video (App content, Foreground service permissions). The permission exists only for sync's background journal uploads: the WorkManager SystemForegroundService typed dataSync and UploadJobService in android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:4-6 and 52-58, driven by the 10 files in android/app/src/main/kotlin/dev/satanshumishra/field_notes/uploads/. The owner said on 2026-10-12 that sync is not really a feature, only something for them and one friend, so Play testers could never use it (it needs a relay invite) and App access would need reviewer instructions. The demo video was recorded and approved but not uploaded. The repository already splits the GitHub APK from the Play bundle with the fieldNotesSelfUpdate Gradle property (android/app/build.gradle.kts:15 and 126-130; release.yml:216 builds the APK with -P fieldNotesSelfUpdate=true, release.yml:224 builds the AAB without it).
options: A: keep sync in the Play build. The owner hosts the approved video (for example unlisted on YouTube), its link goes into the Data sync declaration (Network processing, Other), App access explains that sync needs a relay invite, then Next, Save and Send for review on the 1.0.0 draft. Reason for: no code change and the 1.0.0 draft can go to review today. Reason against: testers meet a feature they can never use, reviewers need access instructions, and every later Play release carries the declaration.

B: leave sync out of the Play build behind the existing fieldNotesSelfUpdate switch, the same way the self-updater is left out. Reason for: the Play app no longer contains the upload service or its permissions, so the declaration, the video and the App access problem disappear, testers get an app with no dead ends, and the owner and their friend keep sync on the GitHub APK. Reason against: a code change through the pipeline and a v1.0.1 tag that replaces the 1.0.0 draft, the video goes unused, Play copies can never sync, and moving from a Play copy to the GitHub APK needs an uninstall because the two are signed with different keys.
outcome: B, chosen by the owner on 2026-10-12: "The next step is to work on Option B". Scope as proposed: the 10 upload Kotlin files move from src/main/kotlin/.../uploads/ to src/selfUpdate/kotlin/...; a stand-in UploadChannel.kt in src/store/kotlin answers that sync is unavailable, so MainActivity.kt:29 stays unchanged; FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC, RUN_USER_INITIATED_JOBS, UploadJobService and the dataSync SystemForegroundService move to src/selfUpdate/AndroidManifest.xml, and the Play build carries none of WorkManager's own foreground-service entries; Settings hides Sync & storage on an Android copy without the upload code, so sync never starts; CHANGELOG.md gains a dated 1.0.1 section; proof is a test that a Play copy shows no Sync & storage plus a check that the built Play bundle requests no foreground-service permission. The switch keeps its name so release.yml stays untouched, and the spec records why. Nothing changes for the GitHub APK, macOS or Windows.
